text: Compute allele (haplotype) frequencies specific SNP sets. Use calculate_allele_frequencies single set; use calculate_allele_frequencies_by_sets multiple sets . estimate argument chooses estimator: "final_sample" (final sample chain, matching SNP-Slice paper; default) "map" (maximum posteriori allocation) point estimates giving literal counts (allele, frequency, count, total_parasites); "posterior" gives posterior mean frequency, SD, credible interval, per-sample mean count (mean_count, n_samples), table depend many MCMC samples used.
code: # Single target set: allele frequencies for SNPs 1, 5, and 10 (final sample) allele_freqs <- calculate_allele_frequencies(result, c(1, 5, 10)) head(allele_freqs) #>        allele  frequency count total_parasites #> 8 ref|ref|ref 0.63428571   333             525 #> 2 ref|alt|alt 0.13523810    71             525 #> 3 alt|ref|alt 0.09142857    48             525 #> 4 ref|ref|alt 0.07428571    39             525 #> 7 alt|ref|ref 0.03619048    19             525 #> 6 ref|alt|ref 0.01714286     9             525  # Posterior: mean, SD, credible interval, and sample-size-invariant mean_count if (!is.null(get_chain(result)$mcmc_samples)) {   allele_freqs_post <- calculate_allele_frequencies(result, c(1, 5, 10), estimate = "posterior", n_samples = 50)   head(allele_freqs_post) } #>                  allele  frequency frequency_sd frequency_lower frequency_upper #> ref|ref|ref ref|ref|ref 0.63409753  0.002736118     0.631020945      0.63884162 #> ref|alt|alt ref|alt|alt 0.13803500  0.005609773     0.124605026      0.14621117 #> alt|ref|alt alt|ref|alt 0.08239172  0.009436347     0.066568441      0.09871358 #> ref|ref|alt ref|ref|alt 0.07315501  0.004944094     0.066568441      0.08405791 #> alt|ref|ref alt|ref|ref 0.04225196  0.007466272     0.032224515      0.04961832 #> ref|alt|ref ref|alt|ref 0.01446428  0.002814664     0.009527899      0.01915281 #>             mean_count n_samples #> ref|ref|ref     332.32        50 #> ref|alt|alt      72.34        50 #> alt|ref|alt      43.18        50 #> ref|ref|alt      38.34        50 #> alt|ref|ref      22.14        50 #> ref|alt|ref       7.58        50  # Multiple target sets: pass a named list for one table per set target_sets <- list(   locus_a = c(1, 5),   locus_b = c(10, 15),   locus_c = c(20) ) freqs_by_set <- calculate_allele_frequencies_by_sets(result, target_sets) # Each element is a frequency table (point estimate: allele, frequency, count, total_parasites; text: store MCMC samples (store_mcmc = TRUE), convergence_diagnostics() reports R-hat effective sample size (ESS), pooled across chains, permutation-invariant summaries run. R-hat informative several chains (run snp_slice(..., n_chains = 3)), single chain still yields split-R-hat.  Constant parameters (e.g. kstar/ktrunc dictionary size settled) zero variance, posterior returns NaN — meaning “parameter move”, failure. title: Calculate Allele Frequencies from MCMC Results — calculate_allele_frequencies
text: results snp_slice_results object containing MCMC results snp_indices vector SNP indices treat single allele estimate estimate report. One "final_sample" (final sample chain, matching SNP-Slice paper; default), "map" (maximum posteriori state), "posterior" (posterior mean, SD, credible interval retained MCMC samples). "final_sample" "map" point estimates; "posterior" needs store_mcmc = TRUE. n_samples Number MCMC samples use estimate = "posterior" (default: 100) interval Numeric (0, 1). Credible interval width estimate = "posterior" (e.g. 0.95). allele_sep Separator allele strings (default: "|") additional_burnin Number additional stored samples discard start retained chain. retained chain already post-burn-, defaults 0. chain chain multi-chain run use. NULL (default) uses top-level estimates, .e. chain highest MAP log posterior (results$best_chain). Give index analyse specific chain instead; see compare_chains.

title: Calculate Allele Frequencies from MCMC Results — calculate_allele_frequencies
text: structure depends estimate. Point estimate ("final_sample" "map") Data frame columns: allele (string representation allele, e.g. "ref|alt|ref" 3 SNPs), frequency (proportion total parasites allele; sums 1), count (number parasites allele), total_parasites (total parasites; every row). Posterior ("posterior") Data frame columns: allele, frequency (posterior mean proportion), frequency_sd (posterior SD proportion across samples), frequency_lower frequency_upper (credible interval, e.g. 2.5% 97.5%), mean_count (mean parasites allele per MCMC sample; scale n_samples), n_samples. Attribute mean_total_parasites: mean total parasites per MCMC sample (alleles).

title: Calculate Allele Frequencies from MCMC Results — calculate_allele_frequencies
text: estimate = "posterior", counts summarized per-sample means rather sums, mean_count mean_total_parasites interpretable regardless n_samples. Frequency uncertainty (frequency_sd, frequency_lower, frequency_upper) computed distribution allele frequencies across MCMC samples.
